China in 26: Possible Trump-Xi-Putin meeting + export controls + fifth plenum

 In this episode of our German-language series “China in 26,” Bernhard Bartsch, Mikko Huotari, and Claudia Wessling discuss a supposedly planned trilateral meeting between Vladimir Putin, Donald Trump und Xi Jinping, a suggested widening of Chinese export controls, and the fifth plenary session of the central committee of the Chinese Communist Party.You can learn more about the topics in this episode here:Why Xi may have his own reasons to avert a US-Russia-China summit | MericsMERICS China Essentials Special Issue: EU-China economic relations enter a critical phase | Merics Watch the podcast as a video:By playing this video, you load content from YouTube (a Google LLC service).
